description: Task manager: an op list driven against one manager (send, regenerate, edit, switch, continue, finish, fail, ask, answer, grant, seen, stop, stopAll), then the final state: sessions projected to what a person sees, running chats in start order, granted permissions, approval answers ('pending' while unanswered), recorded metrics, and the messages each turn was sent. The agent loop is stubbed; finish and fail resolve the earliest unsettled turn for a chat.
